name: api-telemetry
description: Catalog of OpenTelemetry instrumentation built into framework `@cyanheads/mcp-ts-core` — spans, metrics, completion logs, env config, runtime caveats, custom instrumentation patterns, and cardinality rules. Use when enabling OTel export, adding custom spans or metrics in services, debugging missing telemetry, looking up attribute names, or deciding what's safe to put on a metric attribute vs. a span.
